text:
Alex: Quick heads up — trying to bring up hf/xbeta-1 for eval and the conversion step is inconsistent.
Priya: repro? what command?
Alex: `redwood convert-hf --src ./hf_models/xbeta-1 --out ./redwood/xbeta-1` -> conversion completes but runtime fails to load tokenizer.
Sean: paste error
Alex: runtime log: "FileNotFoundError: tokenizer_config.json found but tokenizer.json missing; fast tokenizer points to vocab.json that isn't present. Falling back to slow tokenizer but slow files are absent too"
Jamie: so we have mismatch between tokenizer.json and tokenizer_config.json — fast vs slow meta disagree. :eyes:
Nate: any quick fix? can we synthesize missing files from hf artifacts?
Priya: usually tokenizer.json (fast) references merges/vocab, tokenizer_config.json (slow) lists special_tokens_map. If they diverge, our loader picks fast by priority and fails. We can try copying special_tokens_map into tokenizer.json or generate a minimal slow tokenizer
Emily: note: downstream quantization run on the converted model showed +4% token-level regression in BLEU on eval set; suspect special tokens mis-encoded -> chat template mapping wrong
Alex: here's quick patch I used locally:
```
# minimal shim
cp tokenizer_config.json tokenizer.json.sample
jq '.special_tokens_map |= . + {"":"<|endoftext|>"}' tokenizer.json.sample > tokenizer.json
```
Alex: after that the model loads, but we should not rely on shims for production
Sean: can we add a converter check that ensures both files present and consistent? fail early with actionable message
Priya: yes — proposal: add a linter step in convert-hf that compares `special_tokens_map` and token ids, and validates that fast tokenizer vocab covers special tokens. If mismatch, emit autogenerated shim + warning and a PR template to fix upstream HF repo
Nate: also add an eval gate: if converted model moves >2% in key eval metrics (nll/perplexity/BLEU) run a "special tokens diff" to highlight likely causes
kg-bot: model-convert-job/xbeta-1 failed -> created ticket INF-3421 (link: https://redwood.example/INF-3421) :ticket:
Jamie: SGTM. I'll file a small RFC for the linter and the eval gate and add a note about not accepting shims for dedicated/private deploys
Emily: adding unit test idea: convert a few HF models with intentionally stripped slow files and ensure converter produces clear error and suggested fix
Alex: thanks — I'll attach the failing HF tarball to INF-3421 and run a small batch overnight. :thumbsup:
